supersedes: CTT_M2_FIXED_U_EIGHT_K_PREMISE_V1, superseded before execution and before any outcome was read
purpose: Test whether retaining one native stochastic forward realization across completed stops improves source ordering when placement U is exactly fixed, using prospectively generated transport realizations as the independent inference units.

scope.route_role: fixed development measurement designs; routes are not independent inference units and are not claimed held out
scope.observation_case_count_formula: 210 carriers * 2 fixed routes * 7 prospective observation transport realizations
scope.inference_unit: prospectively generated observation transport realization O0..O6; source ranks and the two routes are aggregated within each realization
scope.gaden_worlds_to_generate_formula: 210 carriers * (6 predictive + 7 prospective observation transport seeds)

placement.definition: for each carrier, use the exact serialized x/y/z coordinate of frozen placement member 0 for every predictive and observation world

prospective_seed_derivation.workspace_text_search_before_run: no occurrence of any derived seed
prospective_seed_derivation.vm_text_manifest_search_before_run: no occurrence of any derived seed under /home/zyc JSON/CSV/TSV/MD/TXT assets

fixed_factorization.K0_sentinel: all 210 regenerated P0 worlds must be byte-identical to the frozen formal context-0/member-0 worlds before any score is computed
fixed_factorization.rng_scope: the frozen native generator passes only the declared seed to gaden_initialize_random_engines before constructing RunningSimulation; the seed controls GADEN Gaussian and uniform stochastic forward draws. The claim is native stochastic forward realization K, not an isolated meteorological transport parameter.

runtime_parity_closure.historical_formal_bank_match: OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 and GADEN_RNG_SEED unset reproduced the frozen P0 shard byte-for-byte
runtime_parity_closure.interpretation: OpenMP thread count is part of the frozen native stochastic forward generator and is held at 4; this is infrastructure closure, not result-driven method tuning

frozen_score_equations.detection: d[s,k,b] in {0,1} is the frozen M1/M3 detection state for candidate s, predictive realization k, and completed physical stop b
frozen_score_equations.event_probability: p[s,k,b] = (0.5 + d[s,k,b]) / 2, hence p is exactly 0.25 or 0.75
frozen_score_equations.coherent_candidate_score: L_coherent(s) = logmeanexp over predictive k of sum over completed stops b of ell(y[b],p[s,k,b])
frozen_score_equations.redraw_candidate_score: L_redraw(s) = sum over completed stops b of ell(y[b],mean over predictive k of p[s,k,b])

primary_estimand.transport_unit_delta: for each prospective observation realization O, arithmetic mean of case_delta across all 210 true carriers and both fixed routes
primary_estimand.primary_effect: arithmetic mean of the seven transport_unit_delta values
primary_estimand.primary_test: one-sided exact sign test over the seven prospective observation transport-unit deltas, with zero deltas excluded

families.observation_source_association: one shared permutation of the 210 observation-source identities per replicate; candidate labels themselves remain a pure invariance
families.candidate_stop_association: for each replicate and route, one shared non-identity stop permutation is applied to candidate predictions for every source and observation realization; observed tapes retain their true order and hit count
families.predictive_K_identity: for each replicate, route and stop, one shared permutation of the six predictive K identities is applied to every source and observation realization, preserving all one-stop K marginals

destruction_controls.observed_and_null_statistic: mean of seven transport-unit deltas; sources and routes are first aggregated within each observation transport realization

pass_rules.overall_direction: mean normalized coherent rank < mean normalized redraw rank
pass_rules.route_nonreversal: for each fixed route, mean delta across 210 carriers and seven prospective observation realizations must be >= 0

forbidden: using source ranks, localization error or physical sequences to choose transport seeds, routes, score, threshold or null maps
changing U0, source strength, wind context, routes, sensor, native physics or RNG hook
treating 210 carriers or 2940 cases as independent inferential replicates
temperature, blend, Top-K, truth/error gate, neural training, planner or closed-loop execution

interpretation_boundary.pass_supports: prospective H01 simulator-internal fixed-U native-stochastic-realization coherence premise for M2
